title: Restricted injective module sheaves are acyclic for étale direct image
statement: Let Λ and Λ′ be commutative rings in Type(u+1), φ:Λ→Λ′ a ring homomorphism, and f:Z→W a morphism of schemes. For an injective sheaf I of Λ′-modules on Z_et, the Λ-module sheaf Res_φ I is f_*-acyclic: for every n≥0 the object (R^(n+1) f_*)(Res_φ I) is zero. Direct image is that of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and acyclicity is [def-sp-acyclic]. Neither flatness of φ nor quasi-compactness of f is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03FD, proof, via Čech vanishing on every object and every slice; Tag 0D6J(3) for coefficient-independent direct image.

proof.text: The Čech argument of 03FD gives vanishing of the positive cohomology of the underlying abelian sheaf of I on every object of Z_et. Res_φ does not change that abelian sheaf. The same module/abelian cohomology comparison for Λ therefore gives vanishing of the cohomology of Res_φ I on every object, as well.

For an étale object V over W, the presheaf computing R^r f_* on Res_φ I is its cohomology on V×_W Z. This vanishes for r>0 by the preceding step. Higher direct image is the sheafification of this presheaf, hence is zero. Equivalently, use the arbitrary-f locally bijective comparison isLocallyBijective_higherDirectImagePresheafToSheaf in the source library; no qcqs hypothesis is needed. This is exactly rightAcyclic.
